# Remove .DS_Store from git history (2025-12-11 22:22Z)

_**User (2025-12-11 22:22Z)**_

Verify this issue exists and fix it:

The `.DS_Store` file (a macOS system file) is being committed to the repository. While adding it to `.gitignore` prevents future commits, the file is already tracked in git history. The file should be removed from version control using `git rm --cached` before committing the `.gitignore` update to prevent polluting the repository with system-generated files. @.gitignore:1-2
